clue.text: Got rid of some current cause of danger in mines

parts.note: to get rid of an employee is to have fired them
an amp is a unit, an amount, of electric current

explanation.surface: Someone sacked a worker over a dangerous electrical fault underground.
explanation.definitionFit: Firedamp is the explosive methane gas that collects in coal pits and threatened miners.

clue.text: Collapse caused by one politician fiddling dole

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
MP is a Member of Parliament

indicators.note: fiddling suggests the word dole is tampered with and rearranged

explanation.surface: A scandal brings down a politician caught cheating the benefits system.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fiddling' turns DOLE into LODE; DOLE is British slang for unemployment benefit.
explanation.definitionFit: To implode is to cave inwards on itself, a synonym for collapsing.

clue.text: Old church rite formerly in the army?

parts.note: ex- as a prefix means former or old
a church service is a religious rite

explanation.surface: A traditional church ceremony once held for the troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Ex-service describes veterans who once served in the armed forces; the question mark flags the playful split.

clue.text: Substantial tastes -no seconds

indicators.note: no here says the letters for seconds are taken away from the word for tastes

parts.note: samples are small tastes of food
S is the abbreviation for second, so seconds give two of them

explanation.surface: A hearty meal of samples, but nobody gets second helpings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no' removes both S letters, the first and the last, from SAMPLES.
explanation.definitionFit: Ample means plentiful or large, the same as a substantial amount.

clue.text: Elemental glow as posh creche opens, maybe?

indicators.note: maybe hints that the letters of the phrase could be reordered into something else

explanation.surface: A smart nursery glows on its opening day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' signals that POSH CRECHE OPENS is rearranged; the 'as' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Phosphorescence is the faint light given off by phosphorus, a chemical element, hence an elemental glow.

clue.text: Means to advertise job with Her Majesty

parts.note: a post is a job or position
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: Advertising a royal appointment.
explanation.definitionFit: A poster is a printed bill stuck up to publicise something.

clue.text: I go wrong getting in drug for entertainer

indicators.note: getting in says one part is placed inside the word for drug

parts.note: pot is slang for cannabis
to err is to go wrong

explanation.surface: A performer admits they messed up by taking drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: A pierrot is a sad-faced clown in white costume, a stage performer.

clue.text: Informed about wife having changed direction

indicators.note: about says the word for informed goes around the wife's letter

parts.note: to sing, past tense sung, is slang for informing to the police

explanation.surface: A grass tells on his wife, who then switches sides.
explanation.definitionFit: Swung means veered or turned, as a vehicle changing its course.

clue.text: Some Mosel, Asti, Chablis? Fairly flexible

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A selection of European wines, with a question about how adaptable they are.
explanation.definitionFit: Elastic means stretchy, able to bend and give, so fairly flexible.

clue.text: New recipe for soup is a work of art

indicators.note: a new recipe remakes the dish, so the word soup is rearranged

explanation.surface: A chef's novel soup is a masterpiece.
explanation.definitionFit: An opus is a creative work, especially a musical composition.

clue.text: Carrying on for a month over by the river?

parts.note: pro means for or in favour of

indicators.note: over says the month's abbreviation is turned backwards

parts.note: Dec is the abbreviation for December
the Ural is a river in Russia

explanation.surface: Continuing for another month by the riverside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' turns the month's abbreviation backwards; 'by' is only a link, and the Ural is a Russian river.
explanation.definitionFit: Procedural relates to how business is conducted, the way things go on, loosely matching carrying on.

clue.text: Cross about goalie and porter

indicators.note: about says the word for cross is turned round

parts.note: a rood is a cross or crucifix
a goalkeeper is called the keeper

explanation.surface: A goalkeeper and a porter are angry with each other.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns ROOD into DOOR; 'Cross' looks like an adjective meaning angry.
explanation.definitionFit: A porter guards an entrance, the same job as a doorkeeper.

clue.text: One third of cake missing — punish by keeping in

indicators.note: one third of a six-letter word is two letters, here the last pair
missing says those letters of the cake are absent

parts.note: a gateau is a rich cake

explanation.surface: A child who ate a third of the cake gets detention.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One third of ... missing' removes AU, a third of GATEAU. To gate is British school slang for confining a pupil to the premises.
explanation.definitionFit: Gating confines a student to school or college grounds as a punishment.

clue.text: Material brought from pit is rejected

indicators.note: is rejected signals the word is sent back, read in reverse

parts.note: coal brought from a pit is mined

explanation.surface: Fabric extracted from a mine is turned down.
explanation.definitionFit: Denim is the hard-wearing cotton cloth used for jeans.

clue.text: Source of plant growth in corner piece — time bed's turned over

indicators.note: in says these letters sit inside the word for the chess piece

parts.note: a rook is the chess piece that starts in a corner

indicators.note: turned over says the word for beds is reversed

parts.note: bed's is read as beds, cots being small beds

explanation.surface: A garden scene: in a corner, a bed is dug over at the right season.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned over' reverses the word for beds; a rook is a chess piece that begins the game in a corner square.
explanation.definitionFit: A rootstock is the root system onto which a plant is grafted, the base from which it grows.

clue.text: Schedule produced by board, one gathered internally

indicators.note: internally says these letters go inside the word for board

parts.note: a table is a board
one is the Roman numeral I
people who gathered met

explanation.surface: A board meeting is arranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A timetable is a list of times, a schedule of events or departures.

clue.text: Deep rest's ordered for one taking things too rapidly

indicators.note: ordered says the letters are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: A doctor prescribes deep rest for a workaholic.
explanation.definitionFit: A speedster is someone who drives or moves very fast.

clue.text: First words from arbiter appearing to be in step

indicators.note: appearing to be in says the arbiter's word is placed inside the word for step

parts.note: a pace is a step
a ref, referee, is an arbiter

explanation.surface: A referee speaks his opening remarks while keeping pace with play.
explanation.definitionFit: A preface is an introduction, the opening words of a book.

clue.text: Article from rock in space provides a drug

indicators.note: from says the article is taken away from the rock

parts.note: an asteroid is a rock orbiting in space
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A news piece about a space rock that supplies medicine.
explanation.definitionFit: Steroids are a class of medicinal and performance-enhancing drugs.

clue.text: Shade one is missing in

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Shade one is missing in', cut short: the wordplay needs the place UMBRIA, which is not in the clue as held, and no scan or search supplies it.

clue.text: It could be read when there's trouble with SA port diplomacy

definitions.text: It could be read when there's trouble

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a port in South America
tact is diplomacy

explanation.surface: Trouble at a South American port calls for diplomacy.
explanation.walkthrough: The Riot Act was a British law read out to order a rioting crowd to disperse.
explanation.definitionFit: Reading the Riot Act was how officials ordered unruly crowds to break up.

clue.text: Apprehension failing initially to gain attention

indicators.note: initially picks out the opening letter of the word failing

parts.note: to have someone's ear is to have their attention

explanation.surface: Worry about failing to win someone's attention.
explanation.definitionFit: Apprehension is anxiety or dread, a synonym for fear.

clue.text: Pushed her in river

indicators.note: pushed suggests the letters are shoved around into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone shoved a woman into a river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rhine is a major European river.

clue.text: Increase in erosion of a coastline

indicators.note: erosion wears and breaks up the phrase, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Coastal erosion is getting worse.
explanation.definitionFit: Escalation is a rise or intensification, so an increase.

clue.text: Skipped in meadow, taking exercise

indicators.note: taking says the meadow word takes on the exercise letters after it

parts.note: lea is a poetic word for meadow
PT is physical training, exercise

explanation.surface: Someone skipped through a field while working out.
explanation.definitionFit: To leap is to jump or skip, and leapt is its past tense.

clue.text: A frolic in a dishevelled state

indicators.note: dishevelled means untidy, so the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: After a romp, someone is left looking messy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'state' looks part of the phrase 'a dishevelled state', but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: California is one of the fifty US states.

clue.text: A bit of adornment for one in resting-place

indicators.note: in says the letter for one goes inside the resting place

parts.note: a bed is a place for resting
a means one

explanation.surface: A decoration placed on a bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A bead is a small decorative ball strung in jewellery.

clue.text: Again studied notice, following soldiers about

indicators.note: following says the notice comes after the other letters

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a body of soldiers
re means about or concerning
an ad is a notice

explanation.surface: Someone checks again a notice about troops.
explanation.definitionFit: To reread is to read once more, to study something again.

clue.text: Request admission, to have a meal inside

indicators.note: inside says the meal word goes within the word for admission

parts.note: admission to a place is entry
to eat is to have a meal

explanation.surface: Asking to be let in for dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: An entreaty is an earnest plea, a request.
